WHERE: / (hero and Global Pool card) vs /pool and /pool/rounds/1248
ROLE: guest, nova VIEWPORT: 1440 and 390
SYMPTOM: At 06:04 UTC the homepage shows round #1,248 'Closes in 13h 55m', 'Enter round', 'Add entries' and, for guests, 'Participate'. /pool shows 'BETWEEN ROUNDS — Next round opens 28 Nov 2026, 08:00 UTC … nothing can be bought before then', and /pool/rounds/1248 shows a green 'Open' badge next to 'SCHEDULED · Not open yet'. items.scenario:
WHERE: /pool (round #1,247 card and Draw threshold card), /pool/rounds/1247, /pool/history
ROLE: guest, nova VIEWPORT: 1440 and 390
SYMPTOM: Settled rounds show 'Participants 0 · min 500' next to 'Threshold Met' and 17,295 qualifying entries. The Draw threshold card shows 'Minimum not met' next to '3.4× the minimum'. The public fairness data contradicts itself.

Fix the DEMO seed so history rounds are internally consistent (participants, threshold, winners, prize split, randomness/verify data) and the hub copy derives from data.
